settings.heading: Before you plug in
settings.text: Straight answers from people who test these on real desks.

settings.question: Why does my Mac only show one external screen?
settings.answer: Base M1, M2 and M3 MacBooks support one external display natively. DisplayLink docks like DualLink DL get around this with a free driver.

settings.question: Thunderbolt 4, USB4, USB-C: what's the difference?
settings.answer: They share the same connector. Thunderbolt 4 and USB4 carry two 4K displays plus fast data; plain USB-C may carry one display or none. Our checker accounts for this.

settings.question: Will it charge my laptop?
settings.answer: Every Linkcore dock passes power through. If your laptop's charger is stronger than the dock's output, it still charges, just slower under heavy load.

settings.question: What's the return policy?
settings.answer: 30 days, no questions, including opened boxes. If our checker said it would work and it doesn't, we cover return shipping.
